# opnsense_routing_gateway (Resource)

Configures an OPNsense routing gateway.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) Logical OPNsense interface identifier, for example `wan` or `lan`.
- `name` (String) Unique gateway name.

### Optional

- `data_length` (Number) Probe payload length in bytes.
- `default_gateway` (Boolean) Prefer this gateway as the default gateway.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this gateway. Defaults to `true`.
- `far_gateway` (Boolean) Allow a gateway outside the directly connected subnet.
- `force_down` (Boolean) Administratively force the gateway down.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway IP address. Leave unset for a dynamic gateway.
- `interval` (Number) Probe interval in milliseconds.
- `ip_protocol` (String) Address family: `inet` for IPv4 or `inet6` for IPv6.
- `latency_high` (Number) High latency threshold in milliseconds.
- `latency_low` (Number) Low latency threshold in milliseconds.
- `loss_high` (Number) High packet-loss threshold percentage.
- `loss_interval` (Number) Packet-loss interval in milliseconds.
- `loss_low` (Number) Low packet-loss threshold percentage.
- `monitor` (String) Optional monitor IP address.
- `monitor_disable` (Boolean) Disable gateway monitoring. Defaults to `true`.
- `monitor_kill_states` (Boolean) Kill states when the gateway is down.
- `monitor_kill_states_priority` (Boolean) Kill states according to gateway priority changes.
- `monitor_no_route` (Boolean) Do not add a host route for the monitor address.
- `no_sync` (Boolean) Do not synchronize this gateway to HA peers.
- `priority` (Number) Gateway priority. Lower values are preferred. Defaults to `255`.
- `time_period` (Number) Monitoring time period in milliseconds.
- `weight` (Number) Gateway weight for load balancing. Defaults to `1`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the gateway.
